sections.title: Metadata validation and pre-existing local environment
sections.text:
The exact declared Composer loop is GREEN on a clean materialization of all seven CURRENT manifests; composer-validation.json binds each member's SHA and byte equality. Library locks are untracked/ignored and excluded from the clean manifest check. No manifest content was omitted or changed for validation.

The checkout loop initially returned exit 2 only for AzGard: its September 29 ignored composer.lock is stale. Attempting composer update --lock --no-install returned exit 1 because the existing ../../../azguard/packages/context path repository is absent. Baseline HEAD versus candidate proves its entire manifest differs only in homepage/support URL values. The ignored lock is preserved, SHA 867d2c81b91e118a11b90d7794ab7ead5f4242e7634756acf018274c072157d8. No dependency/path/vendor repair was made. Other six manifests pass in the original checkout. The local AzGard lock/path problem remains visible; the package metadata gate is proven in the clean byte-identical materialization rather than claiming the initial checkout command passed.
